newsitem.title: USA: KPMG Peat and Baymark dissolve strategic alliance.
newsitem.headline: KPMG Peat and Baymark dissolve strategic alliance.

text.p: KPMG Peat Marwick LLP and BayMark Capital LLC said on Friday that they have dissolved their strategic alliance to provide financial advisory and investment banking services to clients.
Terms of the agreement entail a "wind-down" period through January 31, 1997 to provide an orderly transition for affected BayMark Capital clients and employees.
The dissolution of the alliance between KPMG and BayMark Capital does not affect KPMG's alliance with the consulting firms Dominion Management LLC and BayMark Strategies LLC.
